jinci-temple.name: Jinci Temple
jinci-temple.price_text: ≈ CNY 70–80 entry; check on the day
jinci-temple.hours: Roughly 08:00–18:00 in summer, shorter in winter · check on the day
jinci-temple.tip: Come early to see the Song-dynasty圣母殿 and the ancient cypresses before tour groups arrive.

twin-pagoda-temple.name: Twin Pagoda Temple
twin-pagoda-temple.price_text: ≈ CNY 20–30 entry; check on the day
twin-pagoda-temple.tip: Climb or circle the two brick pagodas for the best close-up of Ming brickwork in the city.

shanxi-museum.name: Shanxi Museum
shanxi-museum.tip: Book ahead online with your passport. The bronze and Jin-state galleries are the highlight.

food-street.name: Liuxiang food street
food-street.price_text: Pay per stall · most snacks CNY 10–30
food-street.hours: Busiest from late afternoon to around 22:00
food-street.tip: Try Shanxi knife-cut noodles and vinegar-dipped dishes. Bring cash or a phone payment app.

old-street-walk.name: Zhonglou Street old-town walk
old-street-walk.tip: Wander the rebuilt old street around the bell tower for snacks and souvenir shops.

fen-river-park.name: Fen River Park
fen-river-park.tip: Walk or rent a bike along the riverside path at sunset for a relaxed city view.

coal-museum.name: China Coal Museum
coal-museum.tip: A quirky stop that explains Shanxi's coal history; the simulated mine tunnel is the fun part.

noodle-class.name: Shanxi noodle-making class
noodle-class.hours: Sessions usually late morning or afternoon
noodle-class.tip: Learn to pull knife-cut noodles, then eat what you make. Confirm English instruction when booking.

jinci-bus-tour.name: Jinci and Tianlongshan day tour
jinci-bus-tour.tip: Covers Jinci and the Tianlongshan grottoes in one day. Confirm entry fees and lunch are included.

shuangta-view.name: Yingze Park viewpoint
shuangta-view.tip: A green city park near the Twin Pagodas; good for a quiet stroll between sights.

vinegar-shop.name: Shanxi aged vinegar shop visit
vinegar-shop.price_text: Free to browse · tastings often free
vinegar-shop.tip: Shanxi is famous for aged vinegar. Taste before you buy and ask about shipping.

taiyuan-museum.name: Taiyuan Museum
taiyuan-museum.tip: Modern building with local archaeology; a good indoor backup on a rainy or smoggy day.

chunyang-palace.name: Chunyang Palace
chunyang-palace.tip: A small Taoist temple with old murals, close to the city centre and rarely crowded.

night-market.name: Yifen Street night snacks
night-market.price_text: Pay per stall · most items CNY 10–25
night-market.tip: Local evening snack street; go hungry and try grilled skewers and noodle bowls.

taiyuan-station-walk.name: Train station to Wuyi Square walk
taiyuan-station-walk.tip: A simple orientation walk from the station into the centre; useful on arrival day.

temple-fair.name: Jinci temple fair (seasonal)
temple-fair.price_text: Usually included with temple entry; check dates
temple-fair.tip: Folk performances and stalls around festival dates; confirm the schedule before you go.
